source_refs.note: 2- Control Centre: a main subheading of 13.1.1 Basic Mechanism of Homeostasis, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 2-2.

blocks.text: The control centres receive information from the receptors, process this information, and send appropriate message to the effectors. These messages ensure that the internal environment remains within a narrow range of set points. These set points are optimal for the body's function. The brain, spinal cord and endocrine glands act as control centres in homeostasis.
